jd_text:
Software Development Engineer in Test - Trainee
Bengaluru (Hybrid, 3 days in office) | Quality Engineering

We are hiring trainee SDETs into the quality engineering group that supports our logistics
platform. This is a fresher position. We are looking for people who have already decided
that testing is the thing they want to be good at, rather than people waiting for a
development seat to open up.

The work
You will join a pod of four engineers and two testers. In the first six months you will:
- Write and maintain functional test cases from user stories and acceptance criteria
- Execute regression cycles before each fortnightly release, and shrink them by automating
  what keeps coming back
- Build and extend UI automation in Selenium WebDriver with Java and TestNG, on top of the
  Page Object Model framework the team maintains
- Write API level tests for our internal REST services and validate responses against the
  contract
- Keep the automated smoke suite running in Jenkins after every deployment to the QA
  environment, and be the person who investigates when it goes red
- Raise clear defects in Jira. A defect nobody can reproduce is not a defect, it is noise

What we need from you
- A BE, BTech or MCA in any branch of computer science, IT or electronics, 2024 or 2025 batch
- Java fundamentals: classes, collections, exceptions, and enough OOP to read a framework
  someone else wrote
- Selenium WebDriver: locators, waits, and why an implicit and an explicit wait should not
  be mixed
- TestNG or JUnit: annotations, assertions, grouping, data providers
- SQL you can write without a reference: select, joins, group by
- The ability to describe the defect lifecycle and the STLC without reciting a definition
- Written English clear enough that a developer in another timezone can act on your bug
  report without a call

Strongly preferred
- An internship where you actually tested something that shipped
- ISTQB Foundation Level
- Postman or REST Assured
- Git, Maven, Jenkins
- Any exposure to BDD with Cucumber

Not required
Performance testing, security testing, mobile automation, Python. You will pick up what the
pod needs.

Process
Online assessment, a technical round on Java and Selenium, a scenario round where we hand
you a feature and you tell us how you would test it, then HR. Offer within two weeks.
